meta.parties: M.Jacolis Appu Et Al. v. W.A. David Perera

rules.statement: An action for definition of boundaries presupposes that the parties to the action are admittedly owners or occupiers of contiguous lands, and the Court of Requests had no jurisdiction to hear and determine an action where the disputed extent of land was the whole of lot 4B which was worth more than Rs. 500.
rules.supporting_quote: "The question of title raised in issues Nos. 1 and 5 at the trial was not incidental to the question of the respondent's right to have the boundary defined but was the real crux of the dispute between the parties. The disputed extent of land was the whole of lot 4B which, according to the respondent himself, was worth more than Rs. 500. The Court of Requests, therefore, had no jurisdiction to hear and determine the action."
